question: Which of the following are cryptogam?
solution:
The correct answer is **Pteridophyta**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cryptogam**:-

 
 
• It refers to a group of plants that do not have visible reproductive structures, such as flowers or seeds.
 
 
 
• **Pteridophyta**:-
 
 
• It is a division of plants that includes ferns, horsetails, and clubmosses, which reproduce through spores and do not have flowers or seeds. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gymnosperm :-**

 
 
• ​It refers to a group of plants that have naked seeds, such as conifers, cycads, and ginkgoes.
 
 
 
• **Dicots and Angiosperms:-**
 
 
• These belong to the division Magnoliophyta, which includes plants that have seeds enclosed in fruits or flowers, such as flowering trees, shrubs, and herbs.
